issue_asks: Support [[Page Name|link text]] in wikilinks, rendering a link with the custom text
URL/class must be identical to [[Page Name]]: base_url, end_url, html_class, custom build_url (receives page name only), wiki_* meta overrides
Whitespace around the page name and the text is ignored
Empty link text falls back to the page name
Plain [[Page Name]] must keep working unchanged

findings.problem: Link text that contains another link or autolink produces nested <a> elements, because higher-priority inline patterns (link, autolink) have already run on the text. The docs say the text is 'intended to be plain text', so this does not block.

The _restore_raw_html helper reaches into the htmlStash and the inline treeprocessor's stashed_nodes to turn raw inline HTML back into text. It works, but it is fairly intricate, and it depends on private internals of the inline treeprocessor.
findings.evidence: repl_inline uses self.md.treeprocessors['inline'].stashed_nodes. Probes with ,

findings.problem: Many of the new tests in test_extensions.py are duplicated in tests/test_autose_issue_3.py. This is redundant but harmless.
findings.evidence: The same cases appear in both files, for example '[[ foo | some text ]]' with the build_url recorder.

commands_run: python probe of ~30 inputs: emphasis, code, raw HTML, entities, escapes, newline, multiple pipes, empty text, whitespace, nested brackets, tables, toc, footnotes, smarty
reviewer.summary: The change meets every point in the issue. The full suite passes: 1183 tests, 52 skipped, no failures. My own probes behaved as expected. Whitespace is trimmed, empty or whitespace-only text falls back to the page name, and the URL and class come from the page name only. Plain [[X]] output is unchanged. Raw HTML in the link text is escaped rather than injected, and entities are kept. The regex rejects `[`, `]`, `|` and newlines in the text, so those inputs stay literal, with no crashes. The only side effect is that a previously literal `[[a|b]]` now becomes a link, which is what the issue wants. Existing tests were not weakened. The remaining findings are minor: a nested `<a>` when the text itself holds a link, and a somewhat intricate `_restore_raw_html` helper that reads private inline-processor state. The docs also note that the piped form does not work inside table cells.

decision.why: every checklist item is true and there is no blocker/major finding
